scope: Synthetic initial states and spacecraft properties; actual pinned space-weather input. Drag displacement is model sensitivity, not measured orbit error.

drivers.name: space-weather.csv
drivers.semantics: Previous-day observed-distance F10.7; current centered 81-day average; explicit seven-element Ap history.
drivers.limits: Centered averages and current/future rows may include estimates or predictions; flux qualifiers are retained. The CSV does not supply a separate provenance flag for each Ap bin.

atmosphere.limits: Empirical neutral atmosphere, not measured density. No implicit drivers or downloads. Model errors are not solver error estimates.

frame_transform.third_body_ephemeris: Astropy builtin instantaneous barycentric position differences; Newtonian GCRS-axis approximation
